answer: License-anchored identity. A PoA profile starts hollow, voteless and rewardless, until its owner binds one trade license. The registry hashes the number, verifies it against the issuer register, and rejects reused licenses. A nightly delta check against the register freezes any identity whose record drifts, and revoked licenses enter a nebula list checked before binding. A $150 bond per applicant is slashed if a stolen license is proven. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 real licenses at about $140 each, about $140,000 with no bulk discount; an honest user pays once and reclaims the bond.
